data.title: Payment reminder: failed direct debit for 2026 membership fee
data.summary: Sportverein Beispielau 1911 e.V. writes that the direct debit for the 2026 family membership fee failed and asks for a bank transfer of EUR 172.50 (fee plus a EUR 4.50 return-debit charge) by 3 December 2026.
data.explanation: Your sports club's bank could not collect your 2026 membership fee by direct debit, so they are asking you to pay the outstanding amount yourself by bank transfer. Check that your bank account had enough funds or that your account details are still correct; if your bank details changed, send the club a new SEPA mandate as they suggest. Transfer the amount to the IBAN given by the stated deadline to avoid further reminder fees or other consequences.
